plain_english_policy: This bill allows the Barbour County Commission to raise pistol permit fees by $5. The extra money collected from this fee increase must be used only for buying and maintaining vehicles for the sheriff's office.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would authorize a specific local tax (fee) hike on gun permits in Barbour County, directing those new revenues exclusively toward vehicle procurement and maintenance for that county's law enforcement agency.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Beasley sponsored the bill to advance this specific fee increase mechanism.
evidence_quotes: (e) Effective after August 1, 2010, the Barbour County Commission by resolution of the commission may increase the fee for the issuance of a pistol permit as provided for in Section 13A-11-75, by five dollars ($5).

The additional fee when collected by the sheriff shall be deposited in the county treasury and used only for the purchase and maintenance of motor vehicles for the Barbour County Sheriff's Department.
